name: Bunny Band
descriptionText: A special W-Engine decorated with a fluffy bunny. Although it is a mere imitation of the real animal, even the fiercest of Hollow Raiders can relieve stress by petting their bunnies while taking a break, which enhances their combat performance. There are many similar models in this series of W-Engines: a portable bunny, a foldable bunny, a furless bunny... Everyone can find one they will not be able to refuse.
